text:
sarah.sales: Heads up — FinEdge POC asked for strict Canada-only residency; they said no metadata or logs may leave Canada. Need quick ops + legal check. Can we pin tenant to ca-central1, support BYOK, and what's the pricing delta vs standard hosted? cc @leo.se
sarah.sales: They want an answer before tomorrow's sync, please keep it brief. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo.se: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Is BYOK required or just preferred? 2) Any allowable egress (metrics/alerting) to US? 3) Do they need an explicit sub-processor attestation for CA-region-only? These change the path.

sarah.sales: BYOK preferred but not mandatory — they'll push if we support it. No egress to US for logs/metadata. They asked for a sub-processor attestation that shows no data leaves CA.

maria.legal: We can produce a sub-processor attestation and redacted list for CA-only hosting. Need to confirm whether our control plane signals (health/metrics) touch US regions — if yes, that violates the ask. @riley.infra can you confirm control plane geography and if we can avoid cross-border telemetry?

riley.infra: Current hosted control plane is in us-east by default. For true "no metadata crossing" there are two realistic options:
- Dedicated reserved capacity in ca-central1 + regional KMS (we can keep inference and associated logs in CA, but control plane credentials/management likely still reach us-east unless we enable regional control-plane routing).
- Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment — full control plane in customer VPC/region, best for strict residency.

riley.infra: Quick notes:
- Reserved CA pool (hard pin) ETA: ~2-3 weeks for capacity provisioning, certs, and routing rules.
- Private deployment ETA: depends on customer's infra but expect longer (4-8+ weeks).
- Telemetry: we can strip PII and keep minimal metrics, but to meet 'no crossing' we need either regional control-plane or Private.

sarah.sales: Customer prefers hosted but will consider Private if needed. They'd like a temporary hosted pin for the POC while evaluating. Pricing??

leo.se: Ballpark pricing:
- Hosted (multi-tenant): baseline token pricing.
- Dedicated (reserved CA pool, hard_pin): ~40-60% premium over baseline (isolated capacity + regional reservations + ingress/egress overhead).
- BYOK setup: one-time integration engineering fee (we typically quote as setup $10k–$25k depending on complexity) + per-month KMS ops charge.
- Private: platform license + infra (significantly higher), usually follows enterprise quote.
I'll draft a scoped estimate and include sizing assumptions (QPS, peak seq len) before EOD.

maria.legal: Also flag for the questionnaire: if control plane or support engineers need to access logs outside CA, we require a contractual exception or a Private deployment. I'll prepare the security Q answers and a CA subproc attestation template.

riley.infra: Routing policy we can apply for the POC (example):
```
route_policy:
  prefer_region: ca-central1
  failover: nearest-available
  hard_pin: true  # tenant pinned to CA reserved pool
  kms: customer_managed
```
Note: hard_pin requires reserved pool and capacity commit; soft_pin is best-effort and may route if pool is exhausted.

sarah.sales: Great. Plan for tomorrow's call 10am PT with FinEdge. Action items: @leo.se draft pricing + sizing, @maria.legal prepare subproc attestation + security Qs, @riley.infra confirm exact list of telemetry/control-plane endpoints and ETA for CA reserved pool. I'll sync with the customer and send calendar invite. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Reminder set for 24 hours (will ping thread).
